chunks: Al-Ḥasan al-Ṣayqal asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the minimum by which the congregation is constituted.
He said: “A man and a woman.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحَسَنُ: al-Ḥasan, the questioner and narrator named in the report

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number required for congregational salat (prayer) in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum number by which congregational salat (prayer) is formed. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام answers that a congregation may consist of two people: a man and a woman.
